text:
Marc: Quick async check — Opal kernel + microbatcher + prefix-cache status. Need PR status, perf numbers, ownership, infra deps, and canary timing. @Anya @Julia @Sam please drop short updates. :eyes:
Anya: I own the kernel PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1420. CI is green except perf-suite flaky on p99 tests. Working on a fallback for the vectorized GEMM path, should have a patch by EOD.
Julia: Microbatcher tweaks landed to staging earlier today. Observed ~12% throughput improvement on seq=512 in synthetic perf runs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1427. Plan: enable on 10% canary next Tue.
Sam: Prefix-cache heuristics — experimenting with adaptive TTL + frequency-based eviction. Small traces show hit-rate +8%, but memory delta +5% on 16GB GPU profiles. Patch ready for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1431. Ping @Kevin for perf-run infra.
Kevin: Infra can spin up perf cluster (4x A100-like nodes) but needs a config tweak in ops/bench-config. I'll open the infra PR tomorrow morning. Also note: canary window requires product/RA signoff before scheduling.
Marc: Clarifying ownership: Anya = kernel, Julia = microbatcher, Sam = prefix-cache. Dependencies: Kevin for perf infra, platform-sre for canary gating, eng-qa for regression evals. Who owns the rollback playbook?
Anya: I will draft a rollback runbook and add to the ops-runbooks repo. Quick rollback command (will include in doc): ```kubectl rollout undo deployment/op-runtime --to-revision=3```
Julia: QA ask — tagging @Lin for eval runs. Can you run prompt sets `relevance-regen-v2` and `latency-slo` against the staging build once microbatcher is enabled?
Lin: On it. Will run both tonight and upload artifacts to s3://redwood-perf/artifacts/opal-2026-03-18. Note: if microbatcher changes token interleaving we need a smoke test for deterministic ordering.
ci-bot: perf-suite build #876 queued; will post p50/p95/p99 and token-level traces here when done.
Sam: Small blocker: kernel PR touches the KV handshake interface — I added a tiny shim in my cache PR but need Anya to confirm the ordering change. It's the second commit in her PR.
Anya: Reviewing that handshake diff now. If it's just ordering I can merge same day; if it requires codegen tweaks we may push to tomorrow.
Kevin: Ops scheduling note — low-traffic canary window is Wed 01:00-04:00 PST. Need on-call coverage for the first two hours.
Marc: I can take Wed 01:00-03:00. @Julia can you take 03:00-04:00?
Julia: Yep I can do 03:00-04:00.
Marc: Next steps checklist: 1) Anya finalize kernel fix and merge, 2) Julia enable microbatcher for 10% canary cohort, 3) Sam finalize TTL flags and memory guardrails, 4) Kevin open perf infra PR and schedule canary once product signoff is in, 5) Lin run evals and upload artifacts, 6) Anya publish rollback runbook. Please update this thread with final PR links and exact canary start time. Thanks! :thumbsup:
